summary: Auth + station isolation feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass including critical API-level station isolation (manager A cannot see B's data even when sending X-Istasyon-Id: B header override). Frontend: login, wrong-password error, station CRUD, user CRUD, top-bar station selector, select-station-prompt gating, change-password dialog, and manager login+station lock — all working. No blockers found.

issues: Missing aria-describedby/DialogDescription on DialogContent — Radix a11y warning in console. Not a functional bug but should be addressed.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Users.jsx and Layout.jsx DialogContent components to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1094 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, stations, users, personnel, schedules, exports) for maintainability.
current_station() correctly ignores X-Istasyon-Id for station managers (returns user['istasyon_id']), which is exactly what enforces API-level isolation. Verified by test test_isolation_personnel.
delete_personnel does not scope db.leaves.delete_many by istasyon_id when cascading (line 351). Since pid is unique across stations this is harmless, but scoping is safer defense-in-depth.
JWT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env — acceptable for preview env, rotate for prod deployment.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login. Not requested but a common auth playbook item.
seed_admin only creates when missing — password change on env var will not update existing admin (as documented behavior).
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (seeded). Manager test users created & torn down inside tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests self-provision stations (TEST_A_*, TEST_B_*) and manager users (TEST_mgr_*) and clean up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_isolation.py covers login, RBAC, station header 400, isolation via header-override attempt, change-password, orphans endpoint, and schedule generation within station. Run: pytest backend/tests/test_auth_isolation.py -v
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Station isolation is enforced correctly in current_station() dependency by ignoring X-Istasyon-Id for role=istasyon_sorumlusu and returning user.istasyon_id from the DB user record.
